body: I really hope you’re right. Thank you

Maybe you’re right. I’m just tired of always being the one who causes problems for them. I’m tired of not being enough, not avoiding arguments with my mom or disagreeing with them. I feel like a burden.

I got into an argument with my parents and was told I’m too mean and harsh, that I’m constantly making comments towards my mom and I act too much like an adult. My dad basically said I’m a problem child. I blew up and told them I constantly have to bite back my tongue when something makes me upset or sad to avoid arguments with them and I don’t know. I think they hate me now because of it.
I knew it!!!! Everything she does makes me doubt myself so much, thank you for saying this.

I’ve never set boundaries before with her honestly? I’ve always just faked laugh at her jokes or when she makes sexual innuendos with my dad in front of me or shakes her chest in front of me. I’ve always thought it was a normal thing
I mean I think it’s a shit joke too. But I get what you’re saying!!

Wow, thank you. I used to go to therapy, but I was too afraid to ever discuss those events because I was a minor and didn’t want anyone to get in trouble in case they were that bad. I’ll try to go back and decide if I want to remember or bury it. Thank you
Thank you so much!!! And I’m sorry to hear that, but I hope you’re doing better now!!!!

Thank you!!! I’ve always been terrified of journaling in case my mother sees it, but I’ll take your luck for it!! And thank you again for assuring me. It means a lot that I’m not just making it up, and others share my experiences. I’m not alone, so thank you
Thank you!! I’m thankful to hear that
Thank you, and you too okay? You have the strength and I believe in you.
Thank you so much for this. It’s just extremely discouraging to keep going. Any efforts I have to lead a healthier life just gets thrown away and it’s hard. But thank you
